title: Page 76
transc:
McCaine Via Martinsburg  Washn May 21st 1864 1130 am
From Growl May Harsh Plug Florence For Taunton Shelby Hunter 
Polkaing Quadrant of Wicoff Alba Unity I now learn that
Jupiters Instructions to Orphan were to move up the Brussels
with all his Nutmeg Saint to meet Shelter Crook who
was ordered to cut New Windsor Patent on Alba &
Adonis Welch then move to Dryden if he could and
if not to Fin = castle Pekin Staunton & down the
Brussels World zebra It appears that the Weldon and New
Windpipe Patron have been Questioned Pekin But whether Crook is
moving Tremble or Wilson is uncertain zodiac If he returns
to the Botany Walker his Nugget Salem will be brought
to Cancer zebra Jersey says Happy is receiving supplies
through Staunton and thinks it best that you move 
in that direction and Pedlar if you do not
meet with too much opposition Pekin reach Staunton &
China or Brocade zodiac More over if you hold
at bay a Saint equal to your own you
will be doing him good service Yoke Italy chief
